source_findings.evidence: Pinned fork adds full-chat accumulation relative to the author collector; 259 changed lines in source diff. Author collector uses the environment manager's per-step observation prompt.
source_findings.impact: Changes history semantics and grows repeated prefill/DT/PPO input work. Effect on task score has not been measured.
source_findings.action: Full author runtime candidate plus existing DT seams; redundant fork chat accumulator absent. Actual owner/candidate prefix comparison passed for WebShop and Sokoban; complete-task quality still requires measurement.

source_findings.evidence: Fork changes include a medical task outside this experiment. Local full_chat_observations rendering overrides the author's memory prompts.
source_findings.action: Removed patch_conversation_observations and launcher full_chat_observations override. Author rendering passes default/initial tests for all three tasks. AppWorld deployment waits for user resolution of the specific history-policy conflict.

source_findings.evidence: git diff between author commit and pristine pinned fork is empty for these paths. This does not cover our installed local patches.
source_findings.action: Audit installed patches individually; do not replace verified official PPO, task dynamics or parsers merely because the enclosing repository was a fork.

source_findings.evidence: Historical pinned-owner parity and current source hash retained; author and pristine fork core_algos.py are identical.
source_findings.action: Preserve official clipped objective and accepted DT advantages. No value model, second GAE, token baseline sampling or replacement PPO.

source_findings.evidence: 13 distinct tokenizer/collector/manager/RPC boundary cases passed across focused runs. These use real owner methods and Qwen tokenizer with explicitly mocked model/environment RPCs, not task-performance evaluation.
source_findings.action: Stop boundary rebased onto the author collector. All 13 boundary tests passed again (29.44s) with the pristine author collector as the valid-input reference. Not deployed; no fabricated terminal reward.

The official verl-agent AppWorld worker and official LOOP experiment are different configurations. Matching 200x240 alone is not alignment with LOOP. Fixed PLAN currently specifies official verl-agent 10/0 rewards; do not silently change the reward alphabet or method.

runtime_findings.probe_configuration: Original actor and sleeping vLLM; B4, 512 synthetic response tokens; config cap remains 32768. Synthetic cost fixture, not task-performance evaluation.
runtime_findings.compile: First 2048 call 47.540s with 7 graph/cache loads; repeat and both 8192 calls had no new Dynamo/Inductor counters.
runtime_findings.interpretation: No repeated shape compilation in this bounded probe. Repeated prefix and per-event native/finite work are measured costs; task-scale savings still require aligned-owner comparison. Do not call all rollout time generation or decode.

sokoban_response_cap.finding: In first two interaction rounds, all 8 author-side Qwen3.5-9B greedy responses exhausted512 tokens. Captured first outputs were unfinished board reasoning before <action>; original parser produced Still. Candidate token/action/reward path matched exactly.
sokoban_response_cap.action: Keep prior1024 response cap; do not substitute paper512 solely by model-independent copying. Retain author prompts/parser and inspect task-quality with appropriate rollout settings before formal restart.
sokoban_response_cap.status: 1024 comparison completed; two actions produced, two still length-limited. Not ready to claim task performance.

appworld_idle_services.interpretation: Actual PSS of the existing official AppWorld CLI services, not summed fork RSS. Read-only snapshot; no service stopped or rewritten.

native_endpoint_diagnostic.scope: Same original actor parameters, official full uncached forward and original DT runner; synthetic EOS-only responses on recorded owner prompts. No reward, task-success or new tolerance test.
native_endpoint_diagnostic.finding: Identical token endpoints have exactly zero DT credit. Nonzero endpoint score differences also occur in the original uncached full forward, before DT finite propagation. In the all-equal fixture first uncached hidden difference is at layer2 (0.0009765625), cached root at layer0. This does not establish a new DT-only defect or an operator tolerance pass.
native_endpoint_diagnostic.acceptance: Keep original FA/FLA operator criteria and existing end-to-end diagnostics; the existing0.02 conservation observation is not a new production gate and no credit renormalization was added.

model_generation_settings.finding: Qwen publishes task/mode-dependent sampling and presence penalties. The fixed training/readout policy uses temperature1 and untruncated token probabilities. Greedy comparisons only isolate owner behavior. Do not insert the model-card penalties into rollout alone and claim an unchanged policy/QV interface.
model_generation_settings.change: No training prompt, parser, reward, policy sampling or response-cap change made.

remaining_evidence: Resolve AppWorld context contract before deploying its renderer; preserve existing rewards and DT/PPO method.
